findings.summary: The follow-up inventory Grep misses callers of read_records and readers that build the records path from a constant.
findings.evidence: The patterns do not include callers of introspect.rs `read_records(`. proposals.rs:557 calls `read_records(self.git.dir())`, a file read of records/ (seam B), and the plan lists proposals.rs only under group (a), the git-tree loaders. Readers that build the records path from a constant are also missed by the literal `join("records")`/`ls_tree_under` patterns: records_import.rs `SOURCE_DIR = "records/"` and steward.rs `RECORDS_SOURCE`/`paths: &["records/jobs", ...]`. Fix: Add `read_records(` (introspect) and Grep for `"records/` string constants to the step 8 and criterion 6 pattern list. Name proposals.rs's `read_records` call as a seam-B follow-up. Name records_import.rs and the steward workspace copy with a note saying whether each is a current reader.
findings.location: Plan step 8 / Demonstration 6 (grep patterns for the §14 inventory)

findings.summary: The §13 reader table becomes partly stale for Status and gh.rs, and the plan says it stays true.
findings.evidence: records-history.md §13 says Status reads `Records::load ... at HEAD` and moves to 'Seam A: branch tip as treeish'. The 'Other Records::load callers' row names `gh.rs`. This slice moves status and land_pr to a worktree file read (closer to seam B) when the worktree exists. The plan claims the §10/§13 text 'stays true', but the Status row and the gh.rs entry become partly stale, and the seam choice differs from §13's plan. Fix: In §14, or by editing the §13 Status and gh.rs entries, state that status (with its forecast headline) and land_pr's lookup now use `load_current`. State that this reads the worktree as files, not the branch tip as a treeish, and why.
findings.location: Dependents: 'Reader-move plan: §10 step 7 and §13 reader table' and Decision 2/3

findings.summary: The gate unit-test fixture names a helper in records.rs tests that does not exist.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-gate/src/records.rs has no `#[cfg(test)]` module today (Grep shows test modules in other gate files, none in records.rs), so 'reuse the existing helper in gate records.rs tests' names a helper that does not exist. tempfile is available to the gate crate (Cargo.toml line 18). Fix: Name the actual fixture: a tempfile temp dir plus `git init` and a commit through `athena_git::Git` in a new records.rs tests module, or a temp-repo helper from another gate test module such as history.rs.
findings.location: Demonstration 2, test seam for athena-gate unit tests

findings.summary: The 'three callers' wording overstates the change: the forecast shares status's load, so only two call sites change.
findings.evidence: The request says only 'the forecast'. The plan reads this as `class_forecasts` inside status (status.rs 794, 1098), which the same `records` value already feeds, so it is not a separate reader. That reading is sound, but criterion 5 counts 'three callers' while only two call sites change. Fix: In §14 and the CHANGELOG, say plainly that the forecast moves with status because it reads status's records, and that only two call sites change.

summary: I checked the plan against the snapshot with Read and Grep; I ran no code. The plan matches the request and the accepted reading. The functions it names exist where it says: `repo_state_dir` (paths.rs 43), `Records::load` and `load_dir` (store.rs 349/356), `landing_files` (store.rs 290), `RecordSet::load` (gate records.rs 27), `Athena::status` with its two loads (status.rs 988-989), `class_forecasts` (status.rs 794, 1098), `Athena::land_pr` with its lookup (landing.rs 846), `code_health::tests::set_up` (code_health.rs 1065) and `StateDir::root`. The changes go where the behavior starts. The land_pr test design holds: `Athena::reconcile` swallows the missing-origin error (reconcile.rs 395-407), and the lookup fails with 'no job matches' (store.rs 536) or 'has no verification' (landing.rs 855) before any remote call. The plan also sets the boundary rules sensibly: worktree-first probing with no fallback on an empty worktree, and landings taken only from the worktree. Each is justified and covered by a test. The status, forecast and land_pr demonstrations use distinct ids and would fail without the change. The dependents list covers every `Records::load_dir` caller (snapshot.rs, gate_counts.rs, the status.rs equivalence test), and the full list of `Records::load`/`RecordSet::load` caller files from my Grep. No athena.toml field is added, and the work fits one producer run. The commit-shape-table rule for landing, history and attribution plans does not apply: no classification function changes. The remaining findings are minor. The inventory Grep misses `read_records(` callers and constant-path readers. §13 of the design doc will be partly stale. One gate test helper named in the plan does not exist. None blocks the criteria.
